bull_bear.body:
- **Dividend INR7/share (70% of FV) — highest in ≥10 years; first dividend in 4 years.**
- Balance-sheet repair: BHEL settlement (INR343 cr received FY26, all obligations closed); JPVL amicable closure; net worth strengthened; ~INR880 cr net cash.
- **INR450 cr "loan"** = surplus cash lent to GE Vernova group cash-pool (benchmarked to HSBC, ~5.5-6.35%, ~0.25% above commercial bank, board-approved/audited) — not an operating loan; earns other income.
- Stated priority: deploy net cash toward services growth + shareholder value (no specifics yet).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Quality of FY26 earnings:** ~INR156 cr of one-offs (ECL INR116 cr + EoT/LD INR22 cr + insurance INR18 cr) inflate PBT; underlying entity EBITDA only ~11% — FY27 lacks the ECL tailwind.
- **FGD demand structurally gutted** by July-2025 norm dilution — a former growth leg now near-dead (~8 GW addressable).
- **Order intake will stay muted** by design (new-build runoff) — top-line optics weak; thesis hinges on core-services compounding + margin.
- **Related-party cash deployment:** INR450 cr parked in GE Vernova cash-pool — governance optics on minority shareholders despite board/audit oversight; ~INR880 cr idle cash with no concrete plan.
- **Durgapur demerger execution:** NCLT/creditor/shareholder/tax/bank approvals pending; supply-chain transition risk after the 5-yr LTSA.
- **Renewable substitution** long-term threat to thermal services (mgmt counters with the "embedded energy" backstop argument).
- Parent/affiliate dependency (GE Vernova) for technology and gas-business adjacencies that GVPIL does not capture.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body:
- Confident, candid turnaround narrative; CFO Aashish Ghai signalled a personal farewell ("the last 2 years... I wish you all the very best") — possible CFO transition to watch.
- Transparent on one-offs: proactively bridged reported vs underlying margins (37.6%→18% Q4; 11% FY) without being pushed.
- Honest on Durgapur ("we tried... could not succeed... reported losses quarter-over-quarter") and on FGD norm dilution killing demand.
- Disciplined "strategy launched July-2024" framing — consistent, repeated message of service-led, high-margin, short-cycle, low-WC.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The headline 37.6% Q4 margin and INR340 cr FY26 PBT massively overstate run-rate — strip one-offs and it's an ~11% EBITDA, ~INR1,269 cr-revenue services business; the re-rating case is *clean cash + dividend resumption*, not the optical P&L.
- The shrinking order book is a *feature, not a bug* — new-build/FGD-EP runoff masks +40% core-services OB growth; investors reading total backlog will misread the business.
- ~INR880 cr net cash on a ~INR1,269 cr-revenue, asset-light, dividend-paying entity is the real story — capital-return / M&A optionality is the swing factor (and the INR450 cr parent cash-pool loan is where it currently sits).
- FGD is effectively *off the table* as a growth driver post-July-2025 — any thesis that leaned on India's FGD mandate is broken; GVPIL's value is the recurring after-market, not emission-control capex.
- Explicitly NOT a play on the gas-turbine/HRSG/combined-cycle boom (that's GE Vernova gas) — a common misread by new investors (asked directly on the call).
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet strengthened to 8x+ Net Worth and 18x+ Bank Balance; dividend declared in 2026.
- Hydro & Gas slump sale provided an INR 295 crores boost to EBITDA, and BHEL settlement released INR 423 crores in bank guarantees.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Core services (the strategic core):** short-cycle, high-margin, low-WC; orders +32% YoY; backbone of future.
- **AQCS / FGD:** structurally impaired by July-2025 (notified 11-Jul, ref also "11-Jun-2025") emission-norm recalibration — only Category A (~8 GW, ~10% of base) now mandatory; Category C (>200 GW, >50%) dropped; Category B optional with tariff pass-through conditions. Net: FGD opportunity "hardly 8 GW," progress slow (Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, central India).
- **New-build boiler / FGD-EPC:** project-closeout mode; backlog winding down by design.
- **Automation & control:** DCS, turbine controls, generator excitation/health monitoring (ALSPA, Mark VIe) — domestic + international orders.
- **Durgapur manufacturing:** 660-acre asset, underutilized & loss-making, being demerged to JSW Energy (NCLT filed).

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Commercial strategy frozen to focus exclusively on Services, exiting new-build and under-utilized manufacturing.
- Expanded international presence across Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Australia, UAE, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Morocco.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:

- [Credit Rating] ICRA long-term credit rating upgraded from BBB+(Negative) to BBB+(Stable) between March 2023 and June 2026.

latest_quarter.title: Financial scorecard (entity / continuing operations)

latest_quarter.body:
- Reported Q4 EBITDA margin ~37.6% is heavily inflated by ~INR41-44 cr BHEL ECL reversal (~14 ppt); underlying Q4 ~18%, FY26 entity-level underlying ~11%.
- Margin mix shift toward shorter-cycle, higher-margin core services and away from low-return new-build/FGD-EP.
- Cost discipline + better project selection + tighter execution cited as the structural drivers.
- Mgmt frames 11% (FY) / 18% (Q4) as the new "base" — but explicitly declined a forward margin range.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
**This quarter (Q4/FY26):**
- Q4 revenue INR316 cr (+19% YoY); FY26 revenue INR1,269 cr (+21% YoY); Core +14%, Upgrades +24%.
- Q4 PBT (cont. ops, pre-exceptional) INR119 cr vs LOSS INR15 cr YoY; FY26 PBT INR340 cr vs INR22 cr — but ~INR156 cr FY26 one-offs (BHEL ECL INR116 cr, Solapur EoT/LD INR22 cr, insurance INR18 cr).
- Underlying entity EBITDA ~11% (FY) / ~18% (Q4) ex one-offs.
- BHEL settlement completed: INR343 cr received in FY26; ECL reversals END 31-Mar-26.
- JPVL matter amicably closed.
- **First dividend in 4 years: INR7/share (70% of FV), highest in ≥10 yrs.**
- Order backlog INR1,628 cr (vs INR2,662 cr) — Jaypee Bina+Nigrie FGD-EP (INR775 cr) terminated; core OB +40% YoY; core orders +32% YoY.
- Durgapur demerger to JSW Energy filed with NCLT; 5-yr LTSA signed.
- July-2025 FGD norm dilution confirmed to have gutted FGD demand to ~8 GW (Cat A only).
- ~INR880 cr net cash; INR450 cr lent to GE Vernova cash-pool.

**Next-quarter / FY27 watch items:**
- FY27 revenue vs implied ~INR1,300 cr base; ~85-90% of OB executable in FY27.
- Underlying margin trajectory now that BHEL ECL tailwind is gone — does ~11%/~18% "base" hold?
- Deployment of ~INR880 cr net cash — M&A, buyback, or stays in parent cash-pool?
- Durgapur demerger close (target CY2026 / within 12 months of 31-Mar-26); NCLT & creditor/shareholder/tax/bank approvals.
- Core-services order momentum (+32% sustainability) and market-share gains toward >18%.
- Possible CFO transition (Aashish Ghai's farewell-toned remarks).
- Alternate supply-chain build-out (~18-month horizon) post-Durgapur LTSA.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **No explicit revenue guide**, but ~85-90% of the INR1,628 cr order-in-hand is short-cycle (<12 months) and executable in FY27 → implied revenue base in the ~INR1,300 cr region (analyst framing, mgmt did not refute).
- **Margins:** "base is set" — underlying entity EBITDA ~11% (FY26) / ~18% (Q4); mgmt declined a forward range but said efforts at par or better. Headline order intake expected to stay muted by design (new-build/FGD-EP runoff).
- BHEL ECL reversals END as of 31-Mar-2026 — no further one-off boost from that source in FY27.
- Durgapur demerger to JSW: target close within calendar 2026; "within 12 months from 31-Mar-26 definitely."
outlook.title: Guidance (next year — FY27)

outlook.body:
- Order backlog INR1,628 cr (31-Mar-26) vs INR2,662 cr a year ago — decline is *intentional* (new-build/FGD-EP closeout + Jaypee Bina/Nigrie INR775 cr termination).
- Core services OB +~40% YoY; new-build/FGD backlog deliberately running down.
- Target serviceable fleet/market ~INR3,500-4,000 cr p.a.; GVPIL current core market share ~18%, aiming to grow.
- International expansion FY26: Saudi, Turkey, Australia, UAE, Malaysia, Indonesia, Morocco (service across installed base).
- FY26 milestones: BHEL new-build boiler contract closure; 3 PG tests; 7 AQCS/FGD operational acceptances; 4 unit completions; 18 first-of-its-kind product orders.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- Compounding core services via PLF-driven thermal duty cycles (higher utilization → more unplanned/planned services demand).
- Servicing **non-GE installed thermal base** (not just GE OEM fleet) — addressable-market expansion.
- International thermal-services footprint (7 new markets in FY26).
- NOT in gas turbines / HRSG / combined-cycle (those sit with GE Vernova gas business, explicitly out of GVPIL scope) — a deliberate non-optionality despite the global gas-plant spurt.
- ~INR880 cr net cash earmarked for "effective deployment" toward services growth / shareholder value (no concrete plan yet — watch for M&A or buyback).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Asset-light turnaround of a GE Vernova thermal-services franchise: shrinking the lumpy new-build/FGD-EP backlog by design while compounding high-margin, short-cycle core services (+32% orders YoY, +40% core OB), cleaning legacy receivables (BHEL/JPVL settlements), demerging Durgapur to JSW — but FY26 profits flattered by ~INR156 cr of one-offs (underlying entity EBITDA only ~11%) and FGD demand structurally gutted by the July-2025 emission-norm dilution.

open.item: Normalized (ex one-offs) FY26 EBITDA margin was 11% at the entity level (18% at Q4 quarter level); management stated the 'base is set' and expects future years to be at least at par with this normalized level, while declining to give a specific forward range

open.horizon: target CY2026, outer bound 12 months from Mar2026
open.item: Durgapur-JSW demerger: NCLT petition filed; realistic completion timeline is within 12 months of 31 March 2026, with an internal target to close within calendar year 2026 (about 3 months ahead of the 12-month outer bound)
Approximately 85-90% of the core services order-in-hand as of 31 March 2026 is expected to be executed within FY27

Targeted core-services fleet market is about INR 3,500-4,000 crore annually; company currently holds roughly 18% share and aims to grow that share, stabilize over the next year, before considering further expansion into other areas

Signed a 5-year (extendable) service agreement with JSW Energy reserving manufacturing capacity at predetermined schedule/price so core services order intake is not impacted; plans to develop an independent alternate supply chain over the next ~18 months
Board recommended an exceptional dividend payout of 70% of face value (INR 7 per equity share), the highest in at least 10 years, subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing AGM
Company has been declared L1 (lowest bidder) on one FGD project, seen as restoring confidence in the FGD pillar after earlier policy-related slowness
NTPC granted suppliers a general amnesty of 8.5 months' time extension on Lot 1/2/3 projects; company pursuing further claims/cost relief but declined to size the amount
